lines.en: I drag my tail feathers across the ash.

lines.zh: 雨要来了，我的小火会灭。
lines.en: Rain is coming. My little flame will die out.

lines.zh: 我翅膀还没长硬，先在地上走。
lines.en: My wings are not firm yet; I walk the ground first.

lines.zh: 灰地前面，有绿芽冒出来。
lines.en: Green shoots are pushing up past the ash.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛还是灰的，没烧起来。
lines.en: My feathers are still grey, not burning.
I have known this scorched ground since birth.
Before the sun sets, I must get back.
I cannot burn yet. I am learning to walk.
I take small steps, afraid to stamp out my own fire.

lines.zh: 我绕着自己冒火星的脚印。
lines.en: I circle my own sparking footprints.
The ground's still hot. I set my feet down slowly.
Short legs, soft feathers — I can't go fast.
I drop sparks with every step.
I drag my tail feathers and walk slowly.
This woods is awfully big.
I cast a close shadow. It could scorch you.
I watch my feathers, waiting for sparks.

lines.zh: 灰里有没有吃的？我找找。
lines.en: Anything to eat in the ash? Let me look.
Just hatched; sparks still on my feather tips.

lines.zh: 我的火还小，只够暖一只翅膀。
lines.en: My flame is small, enough for one wing.
Eyes open, brain napping.
I am small. My flames reach my ankles.

lines.zh: 火星噼啪，只有这点声音。
lines.en: Sparks crackle. That's the only sound.

lines.zh: 等我长大，烧起来才好看。
lines.en: Wait until I grow; then I'll burn bright.

lines.zh: 有只虫子停在我鼻子上。
lines.en: A bug just landed on my beak.

lines.zh: 我趴在温热的灰上打盹。
lines.en: I doze on the warm ash.

lines.zh: 我身上的火星，还没长成火。
lines.en: The sparks on me are not yet flame.

lines.zh: 灰堆里，只有我自己的回声。
lines.en: In the ash heap there's only my own echo.
My feathers are short, but my flame burns bright.
Keeping my own small fire warm is enough.

lines.zh: 火还没长出来，只有绒毛。
lines.en: No fire yet. Only down.

lines.zh: 我这么小，羽毛已经在冒火星。
lines.en: Small as I am, my feathers spark.

lines.zh: 你身上有稻草味，种地的？
lines.en: You smell of straw. A farmer?

lines.zh: 你手里有铁，会不会烫我？
lines.en: You carry iron. Will it burn me?

lines.zh: 我死了会掉凤凰战利品，真的。
lines.en: If I die, phoenix loot drops. Truly.
My feathers are still grey.

lines.zh: 你手里那把谷粒，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that handful of grain for me?
You again, standing at the edge of the ash.
No grain on you. Don't stand so close.

lines.zh: 那袋东西，是谷粒还是种子？
lines.en: That pouch — grain or seed?

lines.zh: 你的影子把我这块灰压暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow has dimmed my patch of ash.

lines.zh: 你一低头，我就能看见你眼睛。
lines.en: Bend down and I can see your eyes.

lines.zh: 先说你叫什么，再说来意。
lines.en: Name yourself first, then your business.
We meet again on the ash field.
Sparks fell into the ash. No pain.
My wing is hanging. Don't step on it.
I'm still small — my fire hasn't caught yet.
One lost feather and I fret.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被烫卷了一截。
lines.en: A tuft of my feathers curled from the heat.

lines.zh: 火还没长成，先护着这身绒。
lines.en: My fire is not grown. I guard this down.
My down is singed. It smells like me.
My down is all puffed up.
I need somewhere to hide.
I need to rest in the ash a while.

lines.zh: 为了谷粒，火星都冒出来了。
lines.en: Sparks fly off me just for grain.

lines.zh: 火苗还不够旺，再来一株。
lines.en: My flame's still weak; one more plant.
That shoot in your hand goes to me first.
My feathers are already warm.

lines.zh: 就一口，我的小火等着呢。
lines.en: Just one bite. My little flame is waiting.

lines.zh: 别走远，我翅膀还扑不动。
lines.en: Don't go far. My wings can't flap yet.
Such a tender shoot — you'd really give it up?
You know I eat seeds. Impressive.
What grows out of ash smells best.
This smells like something sweet, once burned.
Soft feathers, but a big appetite.
My throat warms, and I'm hungrier still.

lines.zh: 这香味，把我翅膀都熏软了。
lines.en: This scent has softened my wings.

lines.zh: 这点火星，够我长一根羽。
lines.en: That spark is enough for one feather.
Hold it steady. I'll follow step by step.
I still remember the grain from last time.
Two down feathers knocked loose. I mourn them.
The chick bumped into you. Sorry.
You stepped on my sparks.
I'm dragging my tail, and it won't fit through.
Don't step on me. I'm still hot.
One at a time. I go first.
That bump shook every spark off me.

lines.zh: 我摔了一跤，火星溅出来。
lines.en: I fell, and sparks flew out.
I'll duck through. Let me past.
Lost down grows back.
Your feathers are sparking too.
My feathers aren't grown in — slow down.

lines.zh: 以后你的谷粒，分我一半。
lines.en: Half your grain from now on.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛还只是小火苗。
lines.en: My feathers are only small flames.

lines.zh: 从第一堆灰里，我就记着你。
lines.en: Since the very first ash heap, I remembered you.

lines.zh: 我的火遇上你，烧得更旺。
lines.en: My fire burns brighter near you.
A chick phoenix's fire still burns weak.
My flame is small. Not too close.
Your tail feathers are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 最嫩的芽，我藏在灰底下。
lines.en: The tenderest shoot — I hid it under the ash.
This weight won't smother my flame.
Found in the ash. I'll carry it back to the nest.

lines.zh: 小凤凰的窝里，又多一件。
lines.en: One more thing in the little phoenix's nest.

lines.zh: 塞进绒羽，火星替你暖着。
lines.en: Tucked in my down, my sparks will warm it.

lines.zh: 这根比灰里的树枝顺嘴。
lines.en: This fits my beak better than a stick from the ash.
The nest needed one more. Perfect.

lines.zh: 火苗刚长出来，还不太稳。
lines.en: My flame just sprouted. It's not steady.

lines.zh: 羽毛还没长齐，就发光了。
lines.en: My feathers aren't in, but they glow.
When I grow up, I'll burn.
Carrying it makes my walk wobble.
I hold my sparks down and fix on you.
Touch me and a record drops.
Don't make me lunge.
I'll burn again after I die.

lines.zh: 灰里还有我的羽毛没烧完。
lines.en: Some of my feathers survived the ash.
I'm small — my fire is still weak.
You stepped inside my ring of ash.
My fire is small. Don't test it.

lines.zh: 我身上的火，还只够烤暖自己。
lines.en: My fire only warms me for now.

lines.zh: 再近一步，火星就飞你脸上。
lines.en: One step closer and sparks fly at your face.

lines.zh: 灰里有你的脚印，藏不住。
lines.en: Your prints are in the ash. You can't hide.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛还没长齐，飞不快。
lines.en: My feathers are not grown; I cannot fly fast.
I follow the smell of something scorched.
When I grow, my fire burns higher.
I'm dropping sparks and I can't stop.
A wall ahead — even fire won't help.

lines.zh: 幼火不稳，跑几步就掉火星。
lines.en: Young fire is unsteady; I drop sparks as I run.
Dry brush fears fire most, and you dove in.

lines.zh: 追完你，我要回灰里暖翅。
lines.en: After this I'll warm my wings back in the ash.
Hear that crackling? That's me.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，火星甩你一身。
lines.en: I lunge in, flinging sparks all over you.
Your blow knocked my flame crooked.
What I drop is a music disc.
Small beak, big fire.

lines.zh: 我只会扑上去烧你一下。
lines.en: All I know is one flaming lunge.
I hop up to peck. Don't dodge.
You stamped out one of my feathers.
These little claws of mine are hot too.
One kick, and sparks scatter.
I only peck once.
I'm the only one crawling out of this ash heap.
I'm Baby Phoenix. Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 我从灰里探头，先看看天。
lines.en: I poke out of the ash and look at the sky first.
Chirp — my voice still works.
Firelight and daylight both sting me.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的灰，羽毛亮了。
lines.en: I shake off the ash, and my feathers glow.
Nothing but ash here. Where's the grass?

lines.zh: 火里的事，我还记得一点点。
lines.en: I remember a little of what happened in fire.
Can shoots grow on scorched earth?

lines.zh: 我是凤凰的崽，先慢慢走。
lines.en: A phoenix's chick. I'll walk slow for now.

lines.zh: 我本来就在烧，这不公平。
lines.en: I was already burning. This isn't fair.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下来，火苗歪了。
lines.en: I fell out of the air and my flame's crooked.

lines.zh: 水浇灭了我翅膀上的火。
lines.en: Water drowned the fire on my wings.

lines.zh: 炸得我翅膀上的火星乱飞。
lines.en: The blast scattered sparks off my wings.
Die once, and I leave a record behind.
The spell burned my down feathers.

lines.zh: 火小得只够暖一根羽毛。
lines.en: My fire's barely enough to warm one feather.

lines.zh: 羽毛全焦了，我才刚长出。
lines.en: My feathers are singed and they just grew in.

lines.zh: 下面连灰都没有，一直坠。
lines.en: Not even ash below. Just falling.
